steps.headline: Offer an extra option to open Google in YouCoded’s browser?
steps.today: You chose Open in Google and suggested YouCoded’s browser. That browser can open websites on desktop and remembers website sign-ins across chats.
steps.problem: Connecting selected Drive files does not sign that browser into Google. A separate website sign-in could let the assistant browse other Google files—not just the ones attached to this chat.
steps.proposal: Keep normal browser opening as the default. Decide whether to also offer an optional desktop action with a warning. Google connection and file selection still use your normal browser. Google website sign-in in YouCoded has not been tested here.

options.label: Normal browser for now
pros: Does not introduce a broader Google website sign-in into the assistant’s browser.
Same opening behavior on desktop and phone.
cons: Switch away from YouCoded to view or manually edit the file.

options.label: Add the desktop option
pros: View and use Google’s editor beside the chat when the website works there.
cons: May need a separate Google website sign-in.
That sign-in follows the browser’s permissions, not the selected-file restriction.
Requires testing and is unavailable on phones today.
